As we do not receive a health certificate from the Channel Islands ,(Jersey, Guernsey), only a traces notification, we are unable to check whether the pre export testing has been done.

We will need to contact the Importer to supply us with a copy of all health certificates for cattle imported from the Channel Islands.

Cattle from Cyprus , Lithuania and Malta will travel with a TRACES ITAHC and we can check the pre import testing has been carried out for these countries.
